title: second-class EVM chain integration pipeline
description:
## Epic: Ship all second-class EVM chain PRs

### Context
We have 16 open second-class EVM chain integration PRs. Each follows the contract at `.claude/contracts/second-class-evm-chain.md`. We have `yarn generate:chain <chainId>` for fast per-chain asset regen (~60s vs 30min).

### Process (sequential, one chain at a time)
For each PR, in order:
1. `gh pr merge --squash` the previous PR (assume CI passes)
2. `git fetch origin && gh pr checkout <number>`
3. `git merge origin/develop` (gets previous chain's squashed changes)
4. Run second-class EVM chain contract review (gap analysis)
5. Fix ALL gaps found
6. `source ~/.zshrc && ZERION_API_KEY=$ZERION_API_KEY yarn generate:chain <chainId>`
7. Ensure migration number is sequential (each PR builds on previous)
8. `yarn lint --fix` (must pass with 0 errors)
9. `yarn type-check` (must pass)
10. Commit all changes + push
11. Move to next PR

### PR Order (by PR number)
1. #11922 - Linea (eip155:59144) - DONE
2. #11905 - Mantle (eip155:5000)
3. #11910 - Cronos (eip155:25)
4. #11923 - Sonic (eip155:146)
5. #11924 - Unichain (eip155:130)
6. #11925 - BOB (eip155:60808)
7. #11926 - Mode (eip155:34443)
8. #11930 - Soneium (eip155:1868)
9. #11931 - Hemi (eip155:43111)
10. #11932 - World Chain (eip155:480)
11. #11933 - Blast (eip155:81457)
12. #11934 - zkSync Era (eip155:324)
13. #11936 - Story (eip155:1514)
14. #11937 - Plume (eip155:98866)
15. #11938 - Flow EVM (eip155:747)
16. #11939 - Celo (eip155:42220)
17. #11940 - Ethereal (eip155:5064014)

### Key Rules
- EVM only (no Cosmos, Solana, UTXO, or non-EVM chains)
- Sequential - order matters for stacked regens and migrations
- `yarn lint --fix` must pass (0 errors) on EACH PR before push
- Each chain's generated assets stack on top of previous
- After ALL beads done: `gh pr checkout 11922` (Linea), `kill 3000`, `yarn dev` for user testing

### Endgame
User tests each chain PR in order. If happy -> stamp -> next.

comments.text: CRITICAL RULE: DO NOT merge PRs on GitHub via gh pr merge. Merging is ONLY done by gomesalexandre after manual testing. To stack regens, merge previous PR BRANCH into current PR. Linea was accidentally merged to develop. lint:fix must pass 0 errors on every PR.

comments.author: gomes
comments.text: MERGE STRATEGY: When resolving merge conflicts, always move the new chain's entries LAST in every list/switch/array. This prevents the auto-resolver from stripping closing braces. The 'keep both' pattern naturally works when the new chain is appended at the end - develop entries first (proper closings), then new chain last (its own proper closing).

title: chain PR merge pipeline contract
description:
## Contract: Sequential Chain PR Merge Pipeline

### PR Order
1. Sonic #11923
2. Unichain #11924
3. BOB #11925
4. Mode #11926
5. Soneium #11930

### Per PR (Sonic through Mode)
1. Checkout branch, fetch & merge origin/develop
2. Run /review-second-class-evm skill, confirm all chains (previous + new) present
3. Verify exactly ONE new state migration vs origin/develop
4. Push the branch
5. Poll CI every 2-3 min until done
6. Check CI status + CodeRabbit comments
7. If comments: address them, commit, push, poll again
8. If CI green + no open comments: approve PR (mention prior testing, Soneium retest later)
9. Enable auto-squash-merge via GraphQL mutation (PR-level only)
10. Wait/confirm PR is merged before moving to next

### Soneium (last one)
Same steps 1-7 only. NO approval, NO auto-merge. User tests manually.

### Hard NOs
- NEVER push to develop
- NEVER manually merge any PR
- NEVER set repo-level merge defaults
- NEVER do any write operation on develop
